members.name: André Torcato
members.current_interests: I'm interested in studying baryons using functional methods. Specifically, solving the baryon's Bethe-Salpeter equation using a quark-diquark model to simplify it to a 2-body system. With this, not only is it possible to calculate baryon masses, but diquark correlations as well. My focus is to predict the diquark correlations of baryons with quarks of different flavors.
